source_text: {SPEAKER_DOPPLER}{PART_000}Huh.{PART_001}$animD18I'll have to think on that.{PART_002}$animD06Great work, you four.{PART_003}It's been another good week of progress.{PART_004}$animD24Head home.{PART_005}Get some sleep.{PART_006}And that goes for Bautista, too.{PART_007}$animD21Tell him it's an order.

source_text: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Yes sir,{PART_001}we do!{PART_002}Quite a large breakthrough already!

source_text: {SPEAKER_DOPPLER}{PART_000}Oh,{PART_001}$animD17that's–{PART_002}$animD06alright.{PART_003}$animD10I'll adjust my expectations moving forward.

source_text: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Matches with Alan's notes.{PART_001}IHe's a good astronomer.{PART_002}I'd trust him.

source_text: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I had something a little different,{PART_001}but you match the astronomer's thinking.{PART_002}I'd trust that.

source_text: {SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Still,{PART_001}there was a visual transmission many weeks ago that seemed to highlight Earth and Mars in our solar system.

source_text: {SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}That's probably because they've identified us at goldilocks planets.

source_text: {SPEAKER_DOPPLER}{PART_000}Then if you don't mind,{PART_001}$animD00as I've gotten older,{PART_002}I've come to realize my greatest quality.{PART_003}I used to think it was my work ethic,{PART_004}$animD23or that I was good at helping others.{PART_005}$animD00I do okay in those departments,{PART_006}but I've realized my greatest quality is neither of those.{PART_007}$animD19It's the ability to surround myself with people smarter than me.{PART_008}$animD22Much smarter.{PART_009}$animD19Akers,{PART_010}$animD20Bautista,{PART_011}$animD21Collins,{PART_012}$animD22{PLAYER_NAME}.{PART_013}$animD20If you'll have me,{PART_014}I'd love to sit in on the Translation with you four.{PART_015}I won't be much help and I won't always be around,{PART_016}but selfishly,{PART_017}$animD23I want to understand the message,{PART_018}the message that they're so desperately sharing with us.{PART_019}$animD22Translation team,{PART_020}will you have me?
